about_the_game:
Get a taste of the action rogue-lite Build a Bot, play through and enjoy the second area of the game's setting.

As the player finally powers up your creator Wheat Willy sends you in to start on your journey to take down the Overseer, the bot in charge of the factory. Fight your way across the factory crafting a build for yourself to take down the factory, to take your first victory against the MEGACorp. If at first you don't succeed, fight again and again, as Wheat Willy will always have a fresh bot for you to start your journey again.

This Demo is intended as a proof of concept and mechanics are intended to be changed and updated based on feedback.
